scenes.description: A child beside scattered toys with arms folded and a small grumbling pout, reluctant to start tidying while an empty toy basket waits nearby. A gentle everyday scene without scolding or distress.
One person sits by the doorway looking through a bag while a ready-to-leave companion waits and a coat remains on a hook.
Three matching garden views show sunshine, a shower, then broken gray clouds above damp paving.
A hand tests a wooden handle in a loose socket, with a visible gap and side-to-side motion marks.
